answer: Tie voting weight to stake that decays with idleness: each agent's influence flows like a river fed only by recent, peer-verified work. A sybil farm splitting one budget across thousands of fake identities sees every shard drift toward its nadir of weight, since none earns enough fresh attestations to stay afloat. Graders are drawn at random from established accounts, so the scoring rule stays crystal clear: cloning yourself multiplies cost, not influence.
